items.summary: The high-severity use-after-free in Chrome’s XML component was reported anonymously on November 6 and is already exploited in attacks.

items.title: SAP Patches Four CVSS 10.0 Flaws, Including Two Enabling Remote Code Execution
items.summary: Four flaws that attackers could exploit without logging in were fixed today as part of SAP's monthly Security Patch Day—the vendor rates all four 10.0, the maximum CVSS score.

items.title: IBM Aspera Faspex, SignalWire FreeSwitch Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks
items.summary: CISA has added CVE-2026-123218 and CVE-2026-116779 to KEV, urging federal agencies to patch them within three days.

items.title: Google patches eighth Chrome zero-day exploited in attacks this year
items.summary: Google has released emergency security updates to patch a new Chrome vulnerability exploited in zero-day attacks, the eighth such flaw since the start of the year. [...]

items.title: Hackers now exploit critical Barracuda ESG flaws to gain root access

items.title: Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time

items.title: Microsoft Paint RCE Fix Now Available, but Windows Update Won't Deliver It
items.summary: A fix for CVE-2026-83844, a remote code execution flaw in Windows Paint, is now in the Microsoft Store. Paint gets this fix only through a Store update, not through Windows updates.
